Elaine (Docs): FYI opened a small follow-up PR for the error-ref page — wants to add a compact UX example for fallback behavior when users hit 429 + streaming interruptions. PR #8243.
Sam (Eng Docs): thanks — can you paste the exact repro snippet you want in the docs? want to make sure Python/TS parity. :eyes:
Elaine (Docs): goal is a tiny, copy-paste example showing: detect 429, trim context by dropping oldest messages, retry with same message idempotently, and resume streaming if partial chunk returned. keep it ~10 lines.
Mira (SDK): I can do TS + Python. quick question: should we show using the Retry-After header or the exponential backoff header we added (x-rw-retry)?
Elaine (Docs): include both as options; note that Hosted sends Retry-After and Dedicated may use x-rw-retry. also call out that SDKs expose a helpers.retryWithBackoff util.
Harry (Runtime): FYI runtime now returns a small resume token in stream footer on preemptive cut; docs should show how to use it instead of naive re-stream.
Sam (Eng Docs): OK — propose two short snippets: 1) sync retry-for-429 with header parsing, 2) streaming resume using resume_token. keep comments inline.
Mira (SDK): draft TS snippet below, will format per code style in PR:
Mira (SDK): ```ts
async function sendWithRetry(req) {
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    const res = await client.generate(req)
    if (res.status===429) {
      const delay = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after']||res.headers['x-rw-retry']||'1')
      await sleep(delay*1000 * Math.pow(2,i))
      continue
    }
    return res
  }
  throw new Error('rate limited')
}
```
Elaine (Docs): perfect — add a one-line note about trimming context: "drop oldest turns until payload fits, then set partial=true flag".
Mira (SDK): adding Python equivalent and a tiny helper for trimming context.
Sam (Eng Docs): can someone add a simple sentence explaining when to prefer model-variant fallbacks vs aggressive trimming? often confused.
Harry (Runtime): add: prefer fallback to a cheaper variant for background tasks or near-real-time where partial quality OK; trim for interactive chats to preserve recent context.
Elaine (Docs): great, please also check the link to the KV-caching section — it was stale and currently points to internal RFC. I replaced it with /docs/kv-cache-overview but please verify anchors.
Sam (Eng Docs): found the stale anchor, fixed it in the branch. also updated the table of example outputs to include the resume_token sample.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/8243 — comments welcome. :white_check_mark:
Mira (SDK): quick lint question — should fenced code blocks for snippets include imports? we usually omit for brevity.
Sam (Eng Docs): omit imports but add a one-line comment showing which SDK and version this applies to (e.g., "TS SDK >= 3.2").
Elaine (Docs): timeline: planning to merge tomorrow EOD if no blockers. tagging @Harley from Security for a quick KMS link sanity check but probably fine.
Mira (SDK): pushing Python snippet in 10m.
Harry (Runtime): small nit — the resume_token example should show how to pass kv_cache hints when resuming, I'll add one inline comment.

Elaine (Docs): thanks everyone. after merge I'll schedule a short changelog blurb for internal release notes and a migration note for customers about the resume token behavior.
Mira (SDK): done, PR updated with both snippets and a short note about header precedence.
Sam (Eng Docs): merging once CI passes.
Elaine (Docs): merged. closing thread. :tada:
